title: Bug: Controlled radio with uppercase type (e.g. type="RADIO") is not restored after click
author: lunaxislu
body_preview: Controlled radio buttons whose `type` is not all lowercase (e.g. `type="Radio"` or `type="RADIO"`) do not get restored to their controlled `checked` state after a click. HTML input types are case-insensitive and the browser treats these as normal radio buttons (`input.type === 'radio'`), but React skips restoring the other radios in the group.
